<img class="mobile_menu_close" src="/images/close-icon" /></div></div></div></div><div id="nbf_page_container"  class=""><div id="nbf_pagemiddle" class="nbf_tpl_pagesection_vertical" ></div><div id="nbf_pagecontent_area" class="nbf_tpl_pagesection_vertical_norwd" ><div id="top_section" class="nbf_tpl_custom top_section mb-lg page_top_section"><section id="top_section_top_section" class="nbf_tpl_pagesection_horizontal_norwd top_section pb-lg " ><div id="top_section_node_text_container" class="nbf_tpl_pagesection_vertical_norwd node_text_container  nbf_first_child" ><h1 id="top_section_node_leadin" class="nbf_tpl_text node_leadin heading heading-xxl nowrap mb-xl" >Kite<br/>Surfing</h1><p id="top_section_node_description" class="nbf_tpl_text node_description narrow body" >FKB is home to one of the longest kitesurfing seasons in the world running from November to July with side onshore wind speeds from 15-30 knots. The unique natural set-up and shallow water lagoon makes it perfect for riders of any level and caters to all disciplines including twin tip, hydrofoil and wing foiling.</p></div><img id="top_section_node_img" class="nbf_tpl_image node_img objectfit-cover" src="images/kitesurfing-header-banner-100/fkb_top_section/?m=nbf" alt="" title=""  /></section></div><div id="additional_info_iter_1_addinfo_cont" class="nbf_tpl_pagesection_horizontal_norwd nbf_tpl_it addinfo_cont reveal pt-xl " ><div id="additional_info_iter_1_addinfo_title" class="nbf_tpl_text addinfo_title reveal nbf_first_child" ><h3 class="heading heading-lg">Everything for kitesurfers</h3>
<div class="body narrow"><div>
	<ul>
		<li aria-hidden="false" data-slick-index="0">
			The latest equipment from leading brand Duotone</li>
		<li aria-hidden="false" data-slick-index="1">
			Rental wetsuits, helmets, life vests, harnesses and more</li>
		<li aria-hidden="false" data-slick-index="2">
			Guest kitesurf storage</li>
		<li aria-hidden="false" data-slick-index="3">
			Members kitesurf storage</li>
		<li aria-hidden="false" data-slick-index="4">
			Teaching and briefing rooms</li>
		<li aria-hidden="false" data-slick-index="5">
			Lockers, showers and changing facilities</li>
		<li aria-hidden="false" data-slick-index="6">
			Competition and media facility</li>
		<li aria-hidden="false" data-slick-index="7">
			First aid and marine rescue craft</li>
		<li aria-hidden="false" data-slick-index="8">
			1 and 2 day packages</li>

			Group, private, semiprivate lessons</li>
	</ul>
